notes:
Primary contact: Mauricio Rivera (Head of Search).
Business drivers: conversion lift from better reranking, reduce infra ops on Elastic, lower per-query cost at scale.
Scale: plan to index 500M–1B vectors in production; currently 120M in their staging index.
Architecture preferences: hybrid approach — high-density ANN shards for recall (HNSW/IVF+PQ), then GPU-based cross-encoder reranker for top-100. Want automatic batching + KV prefix caching to lower per-token compute on reranker.
Performance targets: end-to-end user-facing latency for search page load ~<150ms (95th), re-rank p99 target <250ms. Throughput: sustained 1000–5,000 qps per region with spikes to 20k qps during peak campaign.
Cost targets: aim unit cost per query <$0.0005 for ANN + <$0.02 for full rerank average using batching/quantization. Very cost-sensitive; reserved capacity + model quantization recommendations critical.
Security/compliance: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS, audit logs for 1 year, EU data residency for EU customers. On-prem package requested for air-gapped fulfillment in APAC pilot.
POC success criteria: 1) 95% of current relevance metrics improved over baseline A/B, 2) cost per query reduced by >=30% vs Elastic+hybrid CPU rerank, 3) sustained indexing throughput of >=10M vectors/day for initial ramp.
Quotes and sentiment: "We need predictable unit economics at this scale or we won't be able to launch personalization across regions." — M. Rivera.
Notes style: shorthand, action items inline. See linked Drive POC architecture and pricing deck for details.
